  "title": "A feature to auto delete all of our own content after say 2 weeks",
  "body": "### Is your proposal related to a problem?\r\n\r\n<!--\r\n  Provide a clear and concise description of what the problem is.\r\n  For example, \"I'm always frustrated when...\"\r\n-->\r\n\r\nYes\r\n\r\n### Describe the solution you'd like\r\n\r\nMastodon has this. With the rise of brigading and stalking, it wont be long before lemmy users start doxxing each other.\r\n\r\nEven automatically hiding content after 2 weeks or a configurable amount would help\r\n\r\n### Describe alternatives you've considered\r\n\r\nUsing mastodon instead\r\n\r\n### Additional context\r\n\r\n<!--\r\n  Is there anything else you can add about the proposal?\r\n  You might want to link to related issues here, if you haven't already.\r\n-->\r\n\r\nNo\r\n",

      "id": 1221568893,
      "url": "https://github.com/LemmyNet/lemmy/issues/2415#issuecomment-1221568893",
      "created_at": "2022-08-21T15:36:18Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "This would be fairly easy to implement, and would just require another user setting."
    },
    {
      "id": 1222824044,
      "url": "https://github.com/LemmyNet/lemmy/issues/2415#issuecomment-1222824044",
      "created_at": "2022-08-22T19:33:15Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "Such a feature makes sense on Mastodon, where you shout things into the void and they disappear in a matter of days. This is not the case on Lemmy, you can have threads remaining on the frontpage for a week or more, especially if you use sort methods like \"new comments\" or \"top month\". If such a feature existed, it would create holes in comment threads, making them unreadable. Even a longer timeout wouldnt necessarily help, because some people likely want to read threads months or years later, for example to look up instructions (remember all the times you end up on an old forum thread from a google search).\r\n\r\nAnother thing is that there is no reason for such a feature to be included in Lemmy, because it can easily be implemented with an API client. That would also reduce the maintenance effort, and probably result in fewer people using the feature."
    },
    {
      "id": 1229275598,
      "url": "https://github.com/LemmyNet/lemmy/issues/2415#issuecomment-1229275598",
      "created_at": "2022-08-27T21:58:11Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": ">makes sense on Mastodon, where you shout things into the void and they disappear in a matter of days\r\n\r\nThe need for permanency (or a void to shout into) is equal on both platforms, there are often quite serious debates on Mastodon as well - Just like there's silly and light-hearted chat on some Lemmy communities.\r\n\r\nBut I agree that it's a problem if parts of the content goes missing from the comment section etc. I call it thread-rot. The API is mentioned. I know people have used simple scripts and tampermonkey to automatically delete old or ALL their comments on reddit. If they want, they will bulk delete. But if there's a an alternative, they might not bother to seek out the tools.\r\n\r\nWhat about anonymizing? A user option that deletes the username from comments and/or posts after a certain amount of time. 2 weeks? 2 months? And for users who want to delete their profile, an option to anonymize all posts as a part of the deletion procedure.\r\n\r\nI think a large portion of people who'd otherwise delete their content outright would find that fair. Prevent threat-rot, increase privacy. Win-win?"
    },
    {
      "id": 1232065608,
      "url": "https://github.com/LemmyNet/lemmy/issues/2415#issuecomment-1232065608",
      "created_at": "2022-08-30T19:17:16Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "> What about anonymizing? A user option that deletes the username from comments and/or posts after a certain amount of time. 2 weeks? 2 months? And for users who want to delete their profile, an option to anonymize all posts as a part of the deletion procedure.\r\n\r\nI agree, that sounds like a much better solution. Right now deleting your account also means that all your posts get deleted, anonymizing them instead would be better to prevent valuable content from disappearing. Would you mind to open a new issue for that, and we close this one?"
    },
    {
      "id": 1232073048,
      "url": "https://github.com/LemmyNet/lemmy/issues/2415#issuecomment-1232073048",
      "created_at": "2022-08-30T19:25:26Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": ">Would you mind to open a new issue for that, and we close this one?\r\n\r\nSure.\r\n\r\n"
    },

      "body": "Thank you!"
